commands: dpkg -s g++ libpq-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends g++ libpq-dev >/dev/null)

{ find /app/.venv /opt/uv-python -name '*.so*' -type f 2>/dev/null | xargs -r ldd 2>/dev/null | awk '/=> \//{print $3}' | sort -u | while read -r f; do dpkg -S "$f" 2>/dev/null || dpkg -S "$(readlink -f "$f")" 2>/dev/null || dpkg -S "/usr$f" 2>/dev/null; done | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u > /app/.acropolis-runtime-debs; true; }

m=''; for p in $(cat /app/.acropolis-runtime-debs 2>/dev/null); do case " libpq5 " in *" $p "*) continue;; esac; dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || m="$m $p"; done; if [ -n "$m" ]; then echo "installing runtime libraries:$m"; . /etc/os-release; case "$VERSION_CODENAME" in jessie|stretch|buster|bullseye) sed -i -e 's|deb.debian.org|archive.debian.org|g' -e 's|security.debian.org|archive.debian.org|g' -e '/-updates/d' /etc/apt/sources.list; echo 'Acquire::Check-Valid-Until "false";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99acropolis-archive ;; esac; apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends $m >/dev/null && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; fi

steps.name: install shared libraries needed by compiled packages

commands: . /etc/os-release; case "$VERSION_CODENAME" in jessie|stretch|buster|bullseye) sed -i -e 's|deb.debian.org|archive.debian.org|g' -e 's|security.debian.org|archive.debian.org|g' -e '/-updates/d' /etc/apt/sources.list; echo 'Acquire::Check-Valid-Until "false";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99acropolis-archive ;; esac; apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq5 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb /var/log/apt /var/log/dpkg.log
